changes.motivation: User requested enabling the dnscrypt-proxy monitoring UI, which had been commented out with a now-outdated TODO claiming the option was unavailable in NixOS stable.
changes.summary: Enabled the dnscrypt-proxy2 monitoring UI in modules/common/networking/default.nix with listen_address=0.0.0.0:8053, privacy_level=1, and enable_query_log=true. Bound to 0.0.0.0 so Tailscale peers can reach the UI; the existing trustedInterfaces=tailscale0 firewall rule already allows this without additional changes.

problems: The commented-out block in modules/common/networking/default.nix carried a misleading TODO comment claiming monitoring_ui was unavailable in NixOS stable. The option was actually supported in the running version (2.1.14), as confirmed by the generated /nix/store toml file. This caused several failed attempts to verify availability (nix eval, locate, systemctl, version checks) before the agent found the ground truth in the generated config. The comment should have been removed or corrected when the feature became available, or replaced with the actual NixOS option path for cross-reference.
